# Transport HMC DSGE Replay Fixture

This is a synthetic SurveyBench online-replay fixture for a non-Neural-OT
domain. It models a topic-plus-seed literature-survey task around
transport-assisted HMC for DSGE posterior inference.

All papers, metadata, source statuses, anchors, citation edges, and blocker
states are fixture facts. They are not live citation data, real download
results, paper-source claims, product readiness evidence, or scientific
correctness evidence.
